about: GTA 6 'It has X, shown' (Delta, slug gta-texts): in Rockstar's 'An Extended Look' (Aug 27 2026, 'captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5'), masked gunmen take over a company's opening party (23:00-23:18, 1380-1398 s); Lucia hides among the guests and texts, and her messages pop up on screen as floating bubbles: 'GUYS EVERYWHERE' while Jason moves through the dark (23:47-23:51, 1427-1431 s) and '10+ guys, auto weps, explosives, sound military...' while she types (23:53-23:58, 1433-1438 s). Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.text: GTA 6: Lucia sends Jason texts, mid-takeover.

lines.text: It starts at a company's big opening party.
Then masked men with rifles crash it.
Jason creeps through the dark. Her text pops up: guys everywhere.
She's hiding with the guests, phone out.
Ten plus guys. Auto weapons. Explosives.
And one gunman is right there.
Would you have sent it? Because again,
